_concepto: Relato en primera persona de un buzo de mantenimiento que, trabajando en la represa de Salto Grande, encuentra a 30 metros de profundidad una bicicleta enganchada en la reja de entrada y, al moverla, descubre una placa con una patente vieja, imposible de estar ahí. Visualmente, todo sucede bajo el agua, en un entorno oscuro, turbio y frío, con haces de luz recortando el sedimento en suspensión; el gancho muestra de cerca la bicicleta imposible, el desarrollo presenta el contexto del buzo trabajando en la represa y el cierre revela la patente y deja la pregunta abierta, repitiendo el encuadre del gancho para buclear.
estilo_imagen: Photorealistic cinematic underwater footage, shot on a full-frame camera with a fast wide lens. Heavy particulate suspended in the water catching the light. Volumetric beams. Deep teal-black water, cold. High ISO grain.
cierre_video: Keep the framing of the first frame. Grainy, cold, photographic. Not animated, not illustrated, not CGI-looking.
solo_sonidos: Low underwater rumble, distant turbine hum, muffled water currents, regulator breathing, subtle metal creaks, faint bubbles.

tomas.descripcion: Male industrial diver in his 30s wearing a full-face diving helmet with visor, thick black drysuit with high-visibility yellow reflective stripes, heavy weight belt, black gloves, and sturdy dive boots. Multiple thick umbilical hoses attached to his helmet and back, including an air supply hose, communication cable, and safety line. No skin visible, all covered by suit and gear.

represa_exterior.descripcion: Underwater view just inside the intake area of a large hydroelectric dam. Massive vertical metal bars forming a security grate, cold dark greenish water, strong directional beams of light filtering from above, lots of suspended particles. Hints of concrete walls and distant turbine structures fade into darkness.

compuerta_fondo.descripcion: Deep underwater near the base of a dam gate at around 40 meters depth. Heavy concrete walls, a huge rusty steel sluice gate with visible seams, thick pipes and bolts, cables running along the walls. Very dark, with only the diver's lamp cutting through dense particulate-filled water.

madre.prompt: Full-body character sheet of an industrial diver underwater, photorealistic. Front, back, and side views. Male in his 30s wearing a full-face diving helmet with clear visor, thick black drysuit with high-visibility yellow reflective bands, heavy weight belt, black gloves, and sturdy dive boots. Multiple thick umbilical hoses attached to his helmet and back for air and communications. No bare skin visible. Neutral underwater background, cold teal water with floating particles, soft volumetric light. Underwater film look, not stylized, not CGI.

Establishing underwater environment for the inside of a hydroelectric dam intake. Tall vertical metal bars forming a security grate close to the camera, slightly rusted. Behind them, dark open water leading into the dam. Strong angled beams of light from the surface catch heavy suspended particles. Concrete walls frame the sides, with distant hints of turbine structures fading into darkness. Deep teal-black water, cold atmosphere, high ISO grain. Photorealistic underwater film.

Deep underwater environment at the base of a large dam gate. Massive rusty steel sluice gate fills part of the frame, with visible seams, bolts, and stains. Thick concrete walls around it, with pipes and cables running along the surfaces. Very low ambient light, only a strong narrow beam from a diver's flashlight illuminating parts of the gate and nearby wall. Water is dense with particles, deep teal-black color, cold and murky. Photorealistic underwater film look.

planos.funcion: HOOK. Mostrar de entrada, en primer plano, la bicicleta imposible trabada en la reja de la represa, con la profundidad y lo inquietante del entorno ya visibles, alineado con el texto y la voz que adelantan el hallazgo.
planos.texto: Encontré una bici a 30 m, adentro de la represa
planos.ve: EXTREME CLOSE-UP of a fully intact rusted bicycle jammed horizontally between the thick vertical metal bars of the dam intake grate, underwater. The wheels, frame, and pedals are clearly visible, covered in algae and silt, with faint light beams slicing through dense floating particles. Background falls quickly into dark teal-black water; no people are visible. The frame is centered on the bike and the bars, with the upper third left relatively clear for text.
planos.mueve: From the first frame the camera pushes in slowly toward the bicycle, while drifting slightly sideways, making the metal bars parallax against the dark water behind. Small debris and bubbles drift past the lens. The bike wobbles subtly in the current but remains stuck between the bars.
planos.audio: [SFX] Muffled low underwater rumble, faint metallic creaks from the grate, distant turbine hum. [Ambient] Constant deep underwater dam ambience with low-frequency vibrations. [Foley] Occasional light clinks of the bicycle frame subtly shifting against the metal bars.

planos.ve: MEDIUM SHOT underwater of Tomás facing the intake grate at about 30 meters depth, seen mostly from behind and slightly to the side to avoid his face. His gloved hands hold the rusted bicycle wedged between the vertical bars. The whole bike is visible, both wheels intact, coated in algae and silt. His helmet light brightly illuminates the bike and bars, while everything beyond the grate drops into almost complete darkness with thick particles in the beam.

As he drags the back wheel sideways, the tire reveals a dark metal plate partially hidden behind it, catching the edge of his flashlight beam.
planos.audio: [SFX] Strained metal grinding as the bike scrapes against the bars, a small burst of silt gushing out. [Ambient] Continuous low underwater drone from the dam structure. [Foley] Tight creaks of Tomás's harness and gloves gripping the frame, dull thumps as the bike bumps the grate.

As the clip progresses, the bike’s frame and rear wheel shift and flex against the bars with visible resistance, dislodging a thick cloud of silt that erupts from around the frame and billows outward, swirling through the light beam. The flashlight beam illuminates embossed characters and a clearly visible old-style plate number format that ended in the year 1998. The bicycle's rear wheel is still partly in frame to the side, jammed against the vertical bars of the grate, echoing the composition of the first shot.

The camera slowly pushes in and eases to almost the same composition as the first shot, centering the bike and the newly revealed plate behind the rear wheel. Fine particles drift across the beam of light as the motion eases to a near still at the end, matching the opening frame for a seamless loop.

voz.texto: Soy Tomás, buzo en Salto Grande.
A 30 metros vi la reja y la bici.
La moví y atrás había una patente del noventa y ocho.
